config._note: asset-management-mvp (2026-07-13), field/enum names renamed to English and three vehicle-only fiscal fields added by hrmq-asset-fleet-merge (2026-08-19): a company-owned item with a guarded custody lifecycle (available -> issued -> checkedIn -> available, or available/checkedIn -> writtenOff, terminal -- the Expense precedent). The data widget shows every field including the three fiscal ones (listPrice/fuelType/companyCarTaxCategory) absorbed from the retired Vehicle schema, with hideEmpty so a non-vehicle Asset's detail page does not render them as empty (design.md D3); lifecycleActions expose exactly the four fragment transitions (issue/checkIn/release/writeOff), never invented. An FK-scoped 'Uitgiftes' object-list (AssetAssignment.assetId = @objectId) is the inbound-relation direction (D2) -- who has held this asset, ordered most-recent-first, rowRoute to AssetAssignmentDetail. The Files widget (signed uitgiftebonnen) runs full-width after the domain cards, the ExpenseDetail receipt placement. Audit history is a sidebar tab.

params.note: asset-management-mvp (2026-07-13), field names renamed and employeeContribution absorbed from the retired CarAssignment schema by hrmq-asset-fleet-merge (2026-08-19): a simple two-panel leaf like OrgAssignmentDetail -- the data widget (issuedOn/returnedOn/issueReceiptSigned/notes/employeeContribution, the last meaningful only when the referenced Asset is category vehicle) excludes assetId/employeeId since Related already resolves and links both the issued Asset and the receiving Employee by name; employeeContribution needs no explicit include -- the widget's exclude-only content shows every other property by default. No child lists (nothing references an AssetAssignment by FK). No lifecycleActions: AssetAssignment carries no x-openregister-lifecycle -- effective-dating lives on issuedOn/returnedOn, not a workflow status (design.md D1). Audit history is a sidebar tab.
